story: Why yes…yes you can rent our fine facility for your next birthday party, bridal shower, or event. Send us a message or give us a call to talk and we’ll see how we can help you have the best time ever in a really great space. Wholly Grounds Coffeehouse, established in 2015, is not just another coffee shop. It’s a family business who’s business is their family. Each person who walks through the door is welcomed into the Hamm family. Every cup of coffee also lends support to another organization. Each month, Jeff and Cheryl choose a worthy cause to donate a portion of their proceeds.
